scope: The ordinary-j=2 lower tail, Item-250 compatibility determinant, and every actual-row rank chart; the reconstructed recurrence is retained only as an explicitly bounded experiment
proved: For every admissible odd r not divisible by 3 and both nu=0,1, the Item-250 lower B-tail satisfies lowerB_nu=2*d_nu term by term.
The lower B-tail is distinct from the affine A-chain coefficient b_nu; no factor 18*c-11 follows.
Writing f=(f0,f1), b=(b0,b1), d=(d0,d1), and U_nu=9*c*b_nu-11*d_nu gives D=f0*U1-f1*U0=9*c*det(f,b)-11*det(f,d).
The exact row minors are Delta01=-z1*D, Delta02=-z2*D, and Delta12=0.
On every actual row z1 is a p-unit: the B_s factorial arguments are below p, the raw kappa_r numerator factors are nonzero and have absolute value below p, and the Item-250 denominator audit applies.
Therefore rank(R)=2 exactly when D is nonzero modulo p.
On D=0 and f nonzero the row rank is one; on f=0 the row rank is one for U nonzero and zero exactly for U=0.
Every actual common collision implies D=0, but D=0 is not sufficient: the remaining incidence is one residual equation when f is nonzero, and U0=U1=0 when f=0.

Within the explicitly bounded recurrence classes there is no nonzero relation of order at most 2 and coefficient degree at most 17, nor of order at most 3 and coefficient degree at most 16; the certificate matrices have full column rank modulo each of two certificate primes.
